entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. I have an order number.
Of course, I can certainly help with that. Could you please provide me with the order number?
It's VF-8675309. Hopefully this doesn't take all day.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero Race Jersey, delivered about 65 days ago. What specifically seems to be the issue with the item?
The jersey is the wrong size. It's way too tight. I need to do an exchange or just get my money back.
I understand. Let me just check the policy for you... Yes, it looks like your order is well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely process that return for you right now.
Fine. So you'll send a label?

Absolutely. And I see here that you're a VIP member with VeloFit. To apologize for the sizing issue, I'd like to offer you free expedited shipping on your next order, so you can get a replacement size much faster. I can process the return for a full refund to your original payment method, or we can use it as credit for the exchange. Which would you prefer?
Whatever. Just do the refund. I'll reorder it later if I feel like it.

Not a problem at all. I've just initiated the full refund process and sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Once we receive the original jersey, the refund will be released. The expedited shipping credit has also been added to your account for whenever you're ready. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
